comparisons.name: network-light
comparisons.description: Finder's Network window in column view, Aqua: device column with the emphasised selection, divider, connection panel, divider. Texts are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms; device pictures and the panel's content are stand-ins.

comparisons.name: network-drawing-light
comparisons.description: The same crop with the device pictures and names masked (stand-in icons, fallback font) and the panel's artwork, texts and buttons masked (stand-ins; the buttons have a bezel this library does not draw): scores the column background, the 17 pt selection, the triangles, both dividers, the panel fill and its bottom line.

comparisons.name: network-dark
comparisons.description: Finder's Network window in column view, Dark Aqua: three devices with the first selected, two 204 pt columns. Texts are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms; device pictures and the panel's content are stand-ins.

comparisons.name: network-drawing-dark
comparisons.description: The same crop with the device pictures and names masked (stand-in icons, fallback font) and the panel's artwork, texts and buttons masked (stand-ins): scores the column background, the 17 pt selection, the triangles, both dividers, the panel fill and its bottom line.

comparisons.name: forced-colors-text-light
comparisons.description: Forced colours, after a click on the first row of the second column of a view whose names are full blocks and whose emphasised text and triangle colours are a marker (red): text and triangle of the focused column's selection are the system's highlight text, not the marker, and so is the triangle of the selected row in the column before it. The colours are the browser's emulated system colours, not Catalina's.

pixels.note: text of the clicked row in the focused column: HighlightText, not the marker
its triangle: HighlightText, not the marker
the row between its text and its triangle: Highlight

text of that row: HighlightText
triangle of a row that is not selected: CanvasText

comparisons.name: states-forced-colors-light
comparisons.description: Forced colours, after a real click on "Two": the selection of the focused column and of the column before it are the system's highlight colour, not the accent and the grey. The colours are the browser's emulated system colours, not Catalina's.

pixels.note: clicked row in the focused column: Highlight, which the forced-colours rule sets over the accent
the row selected before is no longer selected: Canvas
